Who was your favorite character in this episode?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wherever we go, we should be careful. We're pretty far from the camp now, and this forest is probably full of dangerous wildlife.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We don't want to walk through a skunk's den or disturb a hornets' nest.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Brendan is right. Maybe we should slow down...
Hector jumps to his feet, and Howard and Brendan follow him.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We just need to... Uh... Fashion some bows and arrows out of these sticks here...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You've got no idea what you're doing, do you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I read 'The Cleaver'. I know about surviving in the wild.
Hector grabs some sticks and tries to tie them together with his shoelaces.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's... That's not working.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We can make this work. Give me your shoelaces! I need more shoelaces!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! This is a stupid idea, and I'm not going to be a part of it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're on your own.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But... We can make this work.
Hector tries pulling back an arrow, but the contraption snaps and part of a branch hits Brendan in the face!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ouch!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just give it up. We're not going to kill anything with that crappy bow and arrow set you threw together in ten seconds.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great. Let's all just starve to death. That's a much better plan.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Forget about food. Eating isn't going to get us out of this forest. We need to keep moving.
The guys get up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll bet there's stuff around here that we can eat.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, but can we eat it without it killing us?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... What about this tree?
Hector reaches up and pulls a piece of fruit off of a branch.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This thing doesn't `look` deadly...
nodes.text_bbcode: This thing doesn't [color=#e23b3b][i]look[/i][/color] deadly...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, I think you're right. That's a papaya. We can totally eat that.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I thought they only grew in tropical regions... Where `is` this boot camp?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought they only grew in tropical regions... Where [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] this boot camp?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wherever we are, at least we have food.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? We're not going to die? Give me some of that!
The boys stuff themselves full of papayas.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I can't believe I didn't think of this sooner. That was delicious.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Usually I'm more of a steak guy, but I'll take fruit salad over starving any day.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, now we've got our strength up. Let's figure out where we're going.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, be quiet! I heard something...
Not so far away in the forest, Officer Monte and his prized tracking badger, Petunia, are right behind the guys!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: We'll find those troublemakers. Come on, Petunia. Stay on their trail!

nodes.speaker: Petunia
nodes.text: Squeak!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's it! We've got them now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That sounded like Officer Monte!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And... Some kind of badger?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whatever it is, we better run!
The guys sprint through the woods with Hector leading the way!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's it! Just keep up this pace!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ack!
Hector stumbles and falls!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Get up! We have to go!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, Hector! You're slowing us down!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry... I... I...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's leave him. He's dead weight!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: As tempting as that is, we can't leave a man behind. Besides, then Officer Monte would know he's on the right trail.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great, now I know how you guys `really` feel about me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Great, now I know how you guys [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] feel about me.

nodes.text: Brendan helps pull Hector to his feet, and the boys begin running again.
After fifteen more minutes of running, all sounds of Officer Monte's pursuit have faded.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I think we lost him. For now, anyway.
The boys collapse and take a minute to catch their breath...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well. This escape could be going better.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, okay. I admit it hasn't been ideal, but it's not so bad. We just need a break.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're all hungry, we're all tired. Let's stop for a minute and eat something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Brendan, hand me some of the food, will you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Me? I thought Hector had it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? Are you saying we lost the rest of our food?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great. I figured we'd die out here, but I didn't think it would be from starvation.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We won't starve. We just need to find some food.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There isn't exactly a drive-thru around here.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. How do you expect to find something to eat in the middle of a forest?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Easy. We're going to...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Max really believed that we could work together and make it home.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He stayed behind so we could escape.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure, I'd like to think that he found a way out... But either way, we've got to do this for him. For Max.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're... You're right. Max wanted us to work together. He'd be so disappointed if he knew we were squabbling like this.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ugh, I guess we have to make this work. For Max's sake.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, this is a start. I've got a feeling we'll figure this out.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Guess what? I don't have a girl anymore! You know why? Because `you` helped her ex hook up with her!
nodes.text_bbcode: Guess what? I don't have a girl anymore! You know why? Because [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] helped her ex hook up with her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And because of you, Linda thinks we burned down the Wilson High library!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And speaking of 'our girls', you let us all go to boot camp to protect the girl you like!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh. Right. Right. Okay, forget about girls!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Using what we know from the location of the sun and the moss growing on that tree, we can get a rough idea of where we're pointed.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And, if you recall from the bus ride here, we know the camp was East of the freeway that we took to get here from Centerscore. If we just go West, we should find that freeway.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow. I'm actually impressed you remembered all of that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I have my moments. Come on, let's go.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So if we're here... And camp is back there somewhere...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Carry the two... Divide by five...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What are you even talking about?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Agh! I can't do it! We're lost! Lost! Hopelessly lost, and we're all going to die out here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa, calm down! Look, if we can't figure this out the smart way, we're going to have to just pick a direction and walk.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That doesn't make a lot of sense, but I guess we've got no other choice...
In northern latitudes, moss grows more on the...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: In northern latitudes, moss grows more on the...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, but how are we going to decide where to go? We need a system.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No problem. We know the sun sets in the... Uh... Snorth?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're doomed.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, just give me a minute! I'll figure this out!
The sun sets in the...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're right. It was a dumb thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I wasn't crazy about Kat, but I guess she was hot, and she seemed really into you. Who knows when you'll find another girl like that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm sorry I made you lose her.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So, I apologized. We cool now?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, you apologized, but you basically told me that I'm going to die alone!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No! Wait! That's... That's not what I meant!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I was just trying to apologize.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I guess I don't always say the right thing, but Brendan... This is one of the few things I really regret in life.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And if I could take it back, I would. At the time, I didn't think Kat was right for you. I thought I was helping you. But now I get it...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm sorry I tried to mess with your life. Really.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess this is a start...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh. And I'm sorry we got sent to boot camp.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Go on.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And I'm sorry we're lost in the woods now.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: All right, all right. Let's start with fixing that last one, and them maybe we'll be cool, all right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Deal. Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, man. Kat wasn't right for you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She was possessive, crazy, and totally controlling.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can do better.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... Maybe you're right. I wasn't that happy with Kat.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, you're a great guy. The right girl for you is going to come along any day now, okay?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And when you're with your next girlfriend, you'll be thanking me for breaking you and Kat up.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know if I'd go that far, but I guess you at least `thought` you had my best interests at heart.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know if I'd go that far, but I guess you at least [color=#e23b3b][i]thought[/i][/color] you had my best interests at heart.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come here, man.
Hector and Brendan share a brief man-hug.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Man, I'm glad that's settled.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hector, this might be hard for you to understand, but sometimes when you date a girl, you start to `care` about her.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hector, this might be hard for you to understand, but sometimes when you date a girl, you start to [color=#e23b3b][i]care[/i][/color] about her.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hey, man, that's harsh... I care about the girls I date...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yet you can't understand why I'm upset that you helped another guy `make out` with my girlfriend!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yet you can't understand why I'm upset that you helped another guy [color=#e23b3b][i]make out[/i][/color] with my girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'd expect something like this from Spud...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But you're supposed to be my friend. You betrayed me just as bad as Kat did!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And you never even apologized for it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan...
After hours of walking...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, you know what? It's actually kind of nice out here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... Peace... Quiet... This isn't half bad... When we're not fighting over something stupid.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe you're onto something, Howard. This whole time, we've been arguing with each other, but maybe the problem isn't with us...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe the problem is the world out there!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: When it was just the three of us bros hanging out, we never had any problems.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's the outside world with its girls and laws and pranks that turned us against each other.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You mean... Society is what turns friends against each other?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Exactly! And I'm tired of fighting with you guys.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So what if instead of trying to find our way back, we stay out here?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why don't we start our own civilization of bros? A society built on friendship and the bro code? A bro-ciety, if you will. Or perhaps a bro-ligarchy.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... We don't have electricity or computers. No Warscrewdriver: Online...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We'll be `living` Warscrewdriver: Online! Er... But `offline.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We'll be [color=#e23b3b][i]living[/i][/color] Warscrewdriver: Online! Er... But [color=#e23b3b][i]offline.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I `have` always wanted to see if my level 75 tracking skills would translate into real life...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] always wanted to see if my level 75 tracking skills would translate into real life...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I guess it's worth a try. It's not like we're going to find our way out of here anytime soon anyway...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Perfect! Howard, begin gathering materials to build our kingdom.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan, draw up a charter.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll continue delegating.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Who needs the outside world? Nothing but problems.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We'll be better off without them all!
As interesting as it would be to see how Hector's bro-ciety turns out, we think you can tell that this isn't the good ending.
Besides, building a new society won't solve the real problems between Hector, Brendan, and Howard.

Ah, relax.
I know how to spot danger a mile away...
Just follow my lead... Step right here. This looks totally safe.
Hector! That's a huge ant hill!
Ack!
The ants swarm over Hector, biting him on his feet and legs!
Hector tries to jump away, but flails helplessly and trips over his own feet! He comes crashing down, falling right on top of a skunk!
Agghh!!!
One desperate sprint away from a skunk later...
Ugh. We reek.
This is worse than the time Ryan shoved me into his gym locker.
Okay, I know this wasn't ideal... But we've come too far to let this little setback ruin everything.
We've just got to keep moving.
Watch out for that ant hill! And don't disturb that bee hive over there.
And let's stay away from that swampy area to our left. That's where alligators are.
Hector... You actually sound like you know what you're talking about.
Thanks, I...
Whoa, watch out! Howard, you almost stepped on that snake!
What?!
Thanks, man.
Yeah, no problem. Just looking out for the team, you know?
After a few more hours of walking...
Hey, did you guys hear that? It sounds like... Like...
From somewhere very close by, the guys hear...
That's it, Petunia! Follow their trail! `You` understand how important it is to bring these troublesome kids to justice!
Squeeeeeak!
Sniff... You're the `only` one who understands... And that's why we won't rest until we find them!
This is ridiculous!
Okay, we need to lose Officer Monte and whatever this 'Petunia' is! Run...
Make your choice!
Through that stream.|Up that mountain.
Run...
Up that mountain?! We'll never make it...
Do you want to go back to boot camp? If we're going to lose Monte, we've got to outlast him! Come on, we can run farther than that old man!
A few minutes later, the trail becomes steeper until the guys have to cling to the rocks to climb up...
Gasp... I've never climbed up a mountain in real life!
Just... Have... To... Keep... Climbing...
Don't worry, guys, it's just a little farther to the top of the mountain...
My hand's slipping! I'm losing my grip! I'm going to die! I'm going to fall off a mountain and die, and it's going to be all Hector's fault!
Hey...
Calm down, Brendan. I've got you. I know this is steep, but just keep going.
Eventually, the guys make it to the top of the mountain... But when they turn around...
What?! Is that Officer Monte climbing up after us?!
That guy just doesn't give up!
You mean all that climbing was for nothing?!
Uh... Adversity builds character!
And so, the guys sprint `down` the mountain.
I... Have... Never... Been... So... Tired... Or... So... Angry... In... My... Life.
Hey, at least we didn't get caught.
It sounded like Officer Monte has some kind of animal tracking us. If we want him to lose our trail, we've got to go through the water.
But that water's going to be freezing cold!
There's no other choice. We've got to do this.
With the sounds of Officer Monte's tracking badger getting closer, the guys quickly wade into the water!
Eep! That's cold!
They race quickly to the other side.
Okay, now we need to put some distance between us and Officer Monte.
The boys sprint through the forest and wait behind some dense bushes.
What's wrong, Petunia? Did you lose the trail?
Sniff... Sniff...
It's okay, girl. This might slow us down, but we'll get those kids...
Heh. Nice. Looks like we're safe for now.
All the same, let's put a little more space between us and them.
After some more walking...
If you guys haven't noticed, it's getting dark. I might not know much about tracking or the law, but I know Officer Monte won't keep searching for us in the dark.
Sure enough, elsewhere in the forest...
It looks like they gave us the slip, Petunia.
Squeeeak.
I know, I know... You're tired. Don't worry, Princess, I'd never keep you running around out here in the dark all night.
Let's get you home, and I'll see if I can find some delicious marmots for your dinner.
Squeak!
Back with the guys...
So, yeah, I think we don't have to worry about Officer Monte for the rest of the night.
At the very least, he'll have to go back to the boot camp for lights out.
Yeah, but since it's getting dark, that also means we're going to need to find some shelter.
Howard's right. We need to focus and find a safe place to stay for the night.
Right. A safe place. How about we...
Make your choice!
Build a shelter.|Sleep in a tree.
How about we...
Think about it. A tree makes perfect sense. We'll be off the ground and away from most of the things that want to eat us.
Well... I guess we can try it.
And so, a few minutes later, the guys climb to the top of one of the nearby trees and stare out at the valley below them.
See? What did I tell you guys? We're perfectly safe... And we can see most of the forest from here.
Suddenly, there's a flash of lightning, and rain starts pouring down!
Agh! We're getting totally drenched!
Hector's brilliant plan didn't include any cover!
You said someplace safe. I don't see anything attacking us.
Of course not... All of the sensible animals are waiting out this storm!
After a very long night, the boys climb down from their tree.
Well, we're all soaked... But at least we're alive.
You know, the two aren't mutually exclusive.
Mutually what now?
Forget it, we don't need a vocabulary lesson, we need to figure out a way home.
All we've got to do is find some branches and lean them against one of these trees...
Oh! I saw something like this on 'Withstander'. They shipwreck all the contestants, and they have to build a place to stay.
Right! This is good. We can do this.
After gathering some supplies and a little construction...
Hey, this actually looks like it won't fall down and kill us.
Yeah, Howard. You must watch that show a lot.
Heh. I never thought all those hours I spent watching 'Withstander' would actually be useful.
Suddenly, there's a flash of lightning, and rain starts pouring down!
Looks like we finished just in time! Get in!
The guys get under the shelter as the rain continues to fall.
Wow, it's a good thing we've got cover.
I hate to say it, but this was a good idea, Hector. You might be a two-faced backstabber, but maybe we'll survive this latest catastrophe of yours.
Uh... Thanks... I think.
After a very rainy night...
Well, at least something went our way.
Now we just need to get home.
Uh... Right... No problem. I'll figure this out. I'll come up with a plan. Just trust me.
Trust you? Hah! You're the last person in the world that I'd trust.
And you know what? I'm not following you anywhere.
Look, man, I know you're upset. But come on, we're in the middle of the woods here. We can't start fighting...
No, you keep saying to put this off, but I can't!
You pulled a really low move, Hector! And I don't even get why you did it! You don't even like Spud! Why would you help him steal my girl?!
It wasn't like that...

nodes.text: I'm telling you, we should just start walking.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure, let's run in circles until we're `really` lost.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So what do you suggest? Just stand here and think about it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! There's got to be some way to use the right-hand rule here... We can just follow along one wall until we reach the end... That's how you solve mazes.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, there aren't any walls here. We're in the middle of a forest.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hector, you're in no position to give orders to any of us! This is all your fault!

nodes.text: Me?! Howard's the one who found the letters! If it weren't for you two stopping to read them, Max would be with us, and we'd be home by now!

nodes.text: So this is `my` fault?!

nodes.text: If Hector had it his way, I `never` would've found out that he coached Spud to kiss Kat!

nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Er... Wait... I mean... Can't we talk about this after we get out of the forest? We kind of have bigger problems right now.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We've been walking for hours. Face it. We're completely lost.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So what? You want to sit down in the middle of the forest and cry about it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What we `need` to do is to keep moving.
nodes.text_bbcode: What we [color=#e23b3b][i]need[/i][/color] to do is to keep moving.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Right, because that `totally` worked for the last four hours.

nodes.text: Agh! It's after five right now! That means I just missed another raid with my guild!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I bet Linda is hanging out with that creep, Kenji, talking about what a stupid loser I am for getting locked up over a dumb prank.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I wonder what Amanda's doing...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you really going to bring up Amanda at a time like this?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't you get it? You protected Amanda, but you threw us to the wolves!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm not one to subscribe to chauvinistic ideals, but I believe Hector often quotes an old adage regarding the placement of bros before women of questionable repute.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry, guys. I didn't mean to drag the two of you down with me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But I just couldn't do that to Amanda. I really care about the girl.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You 'really care' about every pretty girl you run into!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is different! Amanda is sweet and innocent and... I couldn't do that to her. If you guys have to hate me for it, then fine.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Don't be stupid. We don't hate you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's just... What a dumb thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Can you tell me that you wouldn't do the same for Linda?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... That's different.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, it's not. Come on, man. I helped you win Linda over at my party. You owe me one.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, okay. I guess I'd do whatever it took to protect Linda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And Brendan, you ditched me plenty of times for Kat. You know you'd sacrifice anything for a girl.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe we're all suckers for girls. Maybe love makes us do crazy things.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Love? Did you just say 'love'?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I... Uh... I mean...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No way... Hector really fell for Amanda... I can't believe it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And it only took a trip to boot camp and a few days living in the wilderness for him to admit it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, hey. Don't... Wait, what's that over there?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hear... A low rumbling... It's... It's...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's the freeway!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes! We did it! I knew the three of us working together would pull through!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We... We really made it! We're out of the woods! Back to running water, electricity, and sweet, sweet Warscrewdriver: Online!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you just hear something?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I thought we covered that... The wonderful sounds of civilization!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... I heard something else...
Suddenly, a figure bursts through the trees!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ah ha! I finally found you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?! No! This can't be how it ends!
But this is how it ends... For this episode, at least!
You helped the boys survive being lost in the woods, and you even helped patch up their friendship.
